patch_section_boundary_rule: Actual outer crown until original transverse mask is zero, with one additional shoulder source rail for normal transition; source profile/old coordinates determine bounds.
base_reference: Actual source triangle with transverse cut removed only; old crown and longitudinal interpolation retained.
new_target: Reference lane-only surface minus p4(transverse depth, interpolated old lane depth) minus lane depth; no blend of old coarse crosscut back through its active lip.
protected: Protected old coordinates/all old X, actual width and exact radial envelope; sampled AABBZ reported separately, not bit-identical.
normal_rule: Actual fresh mesh corner normals in active groove, taper to old inputs only beyond angular lip and zero transverse shoulder mask.
visual_requirement: No pinched bulges or stepped lips in native same-camera gray before reflection/material/96.
